models._note: Judge must differ from generator. claude-fable-5-1 is the tier above Opus if step-1 worlds read thin.

_note_sampling: temperature is null because both configured models reject it: claude-opus-5-5 returns 400 on any temperature, claude-sonnet-5-5 on any non-default value, and API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic SDK >= 2) on any value at all. Generation at 1.0 was the default, so nothing is lost there; judging at 0.0 has no replacement, so use judge_samples > 1 if score stability matters. A non-null value is sent as-is (for a model that accepts it).
_note_tokens: Both models think adaptively and thinking cannot be disabled; thinking tokens count toward max_tokens and are billed as output. 6000/1500 would truncate a full world + prose. effort is the thinking-depth control (Opus 5.5 defaults to medium, so it is set explicitly).

pricing_usd_per_mtok._note: Standard first-party list prices; batch_discount is applied on top. Used only for the pre-submit estimate.
